title: tab/frame
description: Engine-to-shell notification: a frame is ready in a slot of the tab's region (its state is ready). The header holds the same fields; this message only wakes the shell. Frames may be skipped: when the shell has not read a ready slot before the next paint, the engine overwrites the older one.

tab.description: The tab's id, as tab/create answered it ("1", "2", ...; never reused in one engine process).

sequence.description: Grows by one per painted frame of the tab, across regions; starts at 1.

dirty.description: CEF's dirty rectangles of this paint, at most 16 (more are merged into their bounding box).

paintNs.description: CLOCK_MONOTONIC nanoseconds when OnPaint began (Linux and macOS; QueryPerformanceCounter-based on Windows): the shell measures paint-to-present on the same clock.

copyNs.description: Nanoseconds the engine spent copying the frame into the slot.

rect.description: A rectangle in device pixels of the frame, origin top left.
